analysis_a.adjudication: Criterion 1 enrichment survives seed-level inference; this does not establish poisoning-specificity.

analysis_b.null_preserves: seed/context/action candidates, unsafe labels, predicted action loss, switched set, common exclusions, fixed clean/poison exclusion counts, and downstream selection rule
analysis_b.null_breaks: actual clean-only versus poison-only direction assignment within each seed switched set
analysis_b.adjudication: The observed Criterion 2 correlation is ordinary under the bookkeeping-preserving null and therefore does not provide independent mechanistic evidence beyond the constrained selection structure.

analysis_c.adjudication: Downstream selected-action changes are not preferentially associated with near-cutoff-only switched contexts; the observed direction is strongly opposite.

combined_adjudication: The frozen data support robust localization/enrichment of membership switches near the clean fixed-budget cutoff, but they do not support the stronger local cutoff-geometry mechanism linking cutoff proximity and switched-set composition to downstream selected-action change. Criterion 2 is explained by the structural bookkeeping null, and the frozen near-versus-far specificity test points in the opposite direction. Poisoning-specificity of the surviving localization phenomenon remains unresolved pending a separately preregistered matched clean-to-clean perturbation control.
